Hi Bill,

I noticed that Burke's Shadows, Book 12 in your Bob Burke series, arrived this September, only a few months after Burke's Trap. Following a retired Delta Force commander through that many books, with his Merry Men and Geeks, is a rare run of momentum.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author. Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

For the new release, one option is a short cinematic trailer and a few promotional reels built around Burke, the Barrett rifle and the team that surrounds him. If a trailer or reels for Burke's Shadows is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production, and it is entirely optional alongside the feature.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Burke's Shadows best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
